thread:
Asha: Quick async — lane clearing before next sprint. Short format: what I did / blockers / today.
Asha: What I did: merged the UX polish for routing rules, filed perf regression ticket. Blockers: two CRs (CR1, CR2) waiting review; spec question re: perf target. Today: need CRs reviewed + spec signoff by 5pm.
Ben: On it — which CR should I pick up first?
Asha: CR1 is the smaller change (remove noisy debug logs), CR2 touches zap caching and needs an e2e run. Links: <cr/1> <cr/2>. Also @Clara can you verify the 95th%-latency numbers in the spec?
Clara: Checking numbers now. Quick note: data team requested pushing rollout by +1 day because of schema freeze.
Miguel: I can take CR2 and run smoke e2e. Any quick test command I should use?
Priya: infra is unblocked — I flipped the feature-flag gate in staging. ✅
Miguel: Using this locally:
```
./run-e2e --smoke --model=redwood-v1 --seed=42
```
I'll post results in ~90m.
DeployBot: Deploy queued — canary rollout scheduled in ~2h. Command: `/deploy redwood-api canary`
Ben: I'll rebased CR1 and remove the noisy logging. Ping me if you want to keep any of the debug traces.
Asha: Thanks. Clara — if numbers look ok, can you add signoff as a quick comment on the spec doc? We need stakeholder signoff before 17:00.
Clara: Will do a pass after this async. If data team holds, we'll shift the rollout window.
Miguel: CR2 tests passed locally, pushed fixes and notes to the PR.
Priya: Left a comment on the spec around cache miss behavior — need confirmation on fallback strategy. @Asha can you confirm?
Asha: Confirmed — fallback goes to the smaller shard model with degraded latency, and we log a metric `inference.fallback_shard` for alerts. I'll update the spec paragraph.
Ben: Taking CR1 review now :eyes:
Asha: Awesome — if both CRs get green by noon I'll slot the canary into the 14:00 window. Otherwise we hold until tomorrow.
Miguel: Merged CR2. Tagging release notes: "fix: stabilize zap caching for short sequences"
Clara: Signoff added to spec with updated latency numbers and note about schema freeze.
Asha: Great work. Quick follow-up: can someone QA the release notes blurb for clarity? Small wording tweak saves back-and-forth with legal.
Ben: I'll glance through and tidy language.
Asha: Thanks team — will circle back after lunch if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
